text.uz: Begona shaharda yo'lni so'rashni va yo'nalish ko'rsatishni, joylashuvni bildiruvchi predloglardan foydalanishni o'rganasiz.
Muloyim so'rash uchun Excuse me bilan boshlaymiz: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum? yoki Could you tell me the way to the station? Bu iboralar «Qanday borsam bo'ladi?» degan ma'noni beradi.

Yo'nalishni buyruq gaplar bilan beramiz: fe'l oddiy shaklda keladi. Go straight on (to'g'ri yuring), turn left / turn right (chapga / o'ngga buriling), take the second turning on the left (chapdagi ikkinchi burilishga kiring), cross the bridge (ko'prikdan o'ting).

Manzilni aniqlash uchun predloglardan foydalanamiz: next to (yonida), opposite (qarshisida), between (ikki narsa orasida), behind (orqasida), on the corner (burchakda), at the traffic lights (svetoforda). Masalan: The museum is opposite the bank.
Fe'lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi, ega kerak emas; inkor uchun Don't qo'shiladi.
between — ikki narsa orasida; next to — yonida; opposite — qarshisida; behind — orqasida; in front of — oldida. Behind bilan of ishlatilmaydi, in front of esa of bilan keladi.
So'rash: «Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?»
Javob: «Go straight on and turn left at the traffic lights.» — to'g'ri yuring va svetoforda chapga buriling.
Davomi: «Take the second turning on the right. The museum is opposite the bank.» — o'ngdagi ikkinchi burilishga kiring; muzey bankning qarshisida.

props.prompt: The museum is ___ the bank and the post office.

reason.uz: To'g'ri: ikki bino orasidagi joylashuvni between bildiradi.
Among odatda uch va undan ko'p narsa orasida ishlatiladi. Bu yerda ikkita bino bor.
Behind bilan of ishlatilmaydi; bundan tashqari, ma'no ham mos emas: gap «orasida» haqida.

question.uz: Choose the correct direction: ___ left at the traffic lights.

hint.uz: Yo'nalish buyruq gap bilan beriladi: fe'l qanday shaklda?

explanation.uz: Buyruq gapda fe'lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi: Turn left at the traffic lights.

question.uz: Write the missing word: The café is ___ the cinema, on the other side of the street. (qarshisida)

explanation.uz: Opposite — qarshisida. Opposite the cinema = kinoteatrning qarshisida.

question.uz: The sentence “The bank is in front the station.” is correct.

hint.uz: In front predlogi qanday so'z bilan to'liq bo'ladi?

explanation.uz: To'g'risi: in front of the station. In front har doim of bilan keladi.

points.uz: Yo'lni so'rash: Excuse me, how do I get to…? / Could you tell me the way to…?
Yo'nalish buyruq gap bilan beriladi: Go straight on, Turn left, Take the second turning…
Joylashuv: next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of, on the corner.
